title: Rebuild from k directions and measure the loss
brief: Rebuild data from k components, confirm that the error is the sum of the dropped squared singular values, and standardise columns so units stop mattering.
hints: reconstruct is one line: mean + scores @ components.T.
reconstruction_error: components, scores, _ = pca_svd(X, k); X_hat = reconstruct(X.mean(axis=0), components, scores); then np.sum((X - X_hat) ** 2).
standardise: (X - X.mean(axis=0)) / std with std = X.std(axis=0, ddof=1). Where std is 0, divide by 1 instead so the column stays at 0.
